description: This file defines classes and methods for integrating AWS SNS publishing functionality into a larger system, including a tool class for publishing messages and a class for managing SNS topics and credentials.

classes.name: AWSSNSTool
classes.description: A tool class for publishing messages to an AWS SNS topic.

classes.name: AWSSNS_Tools
classes.description: A class implementing INode for managing AWS SNS interactions, including listing topics and initializing SNS clients.

methods.name: loadMethods.listTopics
methods.description: Loads available SNS topics from AWS in the specified region.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SNS tool with credentials and selected topic ARN.
